rationale: The change modifies the Evaluation Target by expanding the task from determining whether braking is required to determining whether braking or an evasive lane-change maneuver is required to avoid collision. This alters T_H1 itself, so the existing representational basis cannot be reused as-is and derivation must restart at RR1. No specific existing ORR is merely revalidated because the target change is upstream of the current ORR set.
